title: AMV Converter
subtitle: Desktop media conversion utility for portable MP4 hardware
summary: Creator and maintainer of AMV Converter, providing an intuitive Windows desktop graphical interface for FFmpeg to re-encode and transcode modern media files into AMV format for legacy and portable hardware.
highlights: Engineered an intuitive Tkinter GUI wrapping complex FFmpeg command-line conversion parameters.
Integrated automated resolution downscaling, aspect ratio preservation, and audio channel remapping.
Handled error tolerance for non-standard framerates and legacy hardware playback constraints.

title: Self-Hosted Agentic AI with OpenClaw on Proxmox
subtitle: Deploying AI agents for automation, information processing, and application development
summary: Deployed OpenClaw, a self-hosted AI agent platform, in a virtualized Proxmox VE environment and experimented with integrating AI models and web search tools to automate practical tasks.
highlights: Deployed OpenClaw in a dedicated Proxmox VE virtual machine, establishing a self-hosted environment for experimenting with AI agents.
Configured the Linux environment and application dependencies required to run OpenClaw, gaining practical experience with system administration and AI service deployment.
Experimented with OpenClaw, Google Gemini, and SearXNG to explore how AI models and search tools can work together in multi-step workflows.
Explored how agentic AI can move beyond conversational responses to execute multi-step tasks, interact with tools, produce usable artifacts, and make changes based on feedback.
Applied Proxmox virtualization and homelab infrastructure practices to support an isolated, self-managed environment for AI experimentation.

techSpecs.Automation Workflows: Hacker News Research, Article Summarization, PDF Generation, Iterative Document Editing
techSpecs.Application Development: AI-Assisted Browser Game Development and Responsive Scaling Debugging
techSpecs.Core Skills: Linux Administration, Virtualization, AI Tool Integration, Workflow Automation, Software Testing, Prompt Iteration, Document Generation

title: DIY Network Attached Storage & UPS Automation
subtitle: Resilient ZFS central storage pool with APC UPS failover and containerized services
summary: Engineered a custom high-availability Network Attached Storage (NAS) appliance running TrueNAS. Delivers centralized network shares (SMB/NFS) for Windows clients with automated ZFS snapshot schedules and APC UPS integration.
highlights: Configured redundant ZFS storage pool with automated snapshot schedules and scrub tasks for data integrity.
Integrated APC Smart-UPS via Network UPS Tools (NUT) to trigger automated graceful shutdowns and prevent filesystem corruption.
Configured secure SMB shares with Windows ACL permissions and Active Directory integration.
Administered automated local and offsite replication routines.

title: Enterprise Level Cisco Network Infrastructure
subtitle: Multi-tier physical Cisco network, including Cisco routers, switches, and console server
summary: Designed, wired, and administered an enterprise network lab featuring physical Cisco switches and routers.
highlights: Segmented network using 802.1Q VLANs separating Management, Corporate LAN, Lab, and Guest/IoT environments.
Configured Cisco IOS routing, inter-VLAN routing (Router-on-a-Stick), access control lists (ACLs), NAT, and port security.
Blended physical hardware deployments with Cisco Packet Tracer simulations to master complex routing protocols and accelerate CCNA certification readiness.
